name: Georgia's K-12 Mathematics Standards
checked: 2026-10-01: every K–5 standard and expectation read from Georgia's K-12 Mathematics Standards (adopted 2021, taught from 2023-24), grade by grade, and checked against GaDOE's standards listing
note: Summaries are our own one-line wording; the official text stays at the source. Each standard (3.PAR.3) is a row, and each expectation (3.PAR.3.2) is a row whose parent is the standard. Coverage counts a standard through its expectations. The Mathematical Practices (K.MP and so on) are left out because they describe how students work, not content.

standards.summary: Connect counting to how many, up to 20.
Count up to 20 objects in lines, arrays or circles, and up to 10 scattered.
The last number counted tells how many, however the objects are arranged or counted.
Say the number one more or one less than a number from 1 to 20.
Name pennies, nickels and dimes and know what each is worth.
Count forward and backward in order within 100.
Count to 100 by ones and by tens, and count back from 20 by ones.
Count on from any number within 100 and count back from any number within 20.
Make and break apart 11 to 19 with place value.
Show 11 to 19 as ten ones and some more ones, putting together and breaking apart.
